summary: Kerb of a roundabout central island; no room to stop.
reasons: Roundabout island, not a parking kerb

drivers.seclusion: Homes 23 m and 25 m away on all sides; open to view.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a roundabout island with a 6 m length; nowhere to pull out of the circulating lane.
drivers.traffic: Junction of three streets with continuous turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the island; no marked parking.

sun_shade: Island partly shaded by trees to the west and south; open to midday sun.
